description: This file defines a Spring Boot REST controller named OrderController that provides endpoints for managing orders in an online shopping system. It includes methods for retrieving user orders, fetching specific orders by ID, creating new orders from the cart, and canceling existing orders.

classes.name: OrderController
classes.description: Spring Boot REST controller providing endpoints for order management, including creation, retrieval, and cancellation of orders.

methods.name: getCurrentUserOrders
methods.description: Handles GET requests to retrieve paginated orders for the current user.

methods.name: getOrderById
methods.description: Handles GET requests to fetch order details by order ID.

methods.name: createOrder
methods.description: Handles POST requests to create a new order based on current cart details.

methods.name: cancelOrder
methods.description: Handles POST requests to cancel an existing order by ID.
